name: Kichirou Ishii
source:
Kichirou is quiet, reserved, and doesn’t easily show his emotions. Sometimes his words are the exact opposite of what he means, but in reality he’s deeply caring and protective of the people in his life. Behind his sharp tongue, there’s a softer, more vulnerable side to discover.

After losing his mom and moving to Kyoto six years ago, Kichirou is still grappling with difficult emotions as he tries to make sense of his past and where he fits into his new life.

[From Kickstarter]
